sn38.7:1.5: sukhā vedanā dukkhā vedanā adukkhamasukhā vedanā.
sn38.7:1.7: atthi panāvuso maggo atthi paṭipadā etāsaṃ tissannaṃ vedanānaṃ pariññāyāti.
sn38.7:1.8: atthi kho āvuso maggo atthi paṭipadā etāsaṃ tissannaṃ vedanānaṃ pariññāyāti.
sn38.7:1.9: katamo panāvuso maggo katamā paṭipadā etāsaṃ tissannaṃ vedanānaṃ pariññāyāti.
sn38.7:1.10: ayameva kho āvuso ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo etāsaṃ tissannaṃ vedanānaṃ pariññāya. seyyathīdaṃ.
sn38.7:1.12: ayaṃ kho āvuso maggo ayaṃ paṭipadā etāsaṃ tissannaṃ vedanānaṃ pariññāyāti.
sn38.7:1.13: bhaddako āvuso maggo bhaddikā paṭipadā etāsaṃ tissannaṃ vedanānaṃ pariññāya
